full.description: This is a gross pathology photograph showing a section of lung tissue. The specimen demonstrates extensive hemorrhagic areas, consolidation, and necrosis within the pulmonary parenchyma. These gross findings are characteristic of a severe necrotizing or hemorrhagic pneumonia, such as that caused by invasive fungal or bacterial infections.
